plugins.name: openspec
plugins.description: Personal engineering standard: OpenSpec (proposal/specs/design/tasks) extended with optional ADRs for durable, hard-to-reverse decisions, plus LikeC4 for living architecture diagrams. Run the `init` skill (user-only) in a new or existing project to apply it.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Personal git workflow conventions: a Conventional Commits skill and a pull/merge request skill (gitflow branches, conventional titles).

plugins.name: tui
plugins.description: Terminal UI media - starting with a record skill that generates a demo video from a spec: one file says what the video shows and how to rebuild the sandbox it was recorded in.

plugins.name: env
plugins.description: Machine and environment management through dotfiles: a machine is a build product of its chezmoi source directory, so installing a tool or changing a config means writing it there and applying, never by hand. Reads the setup's own lanes and conventions instead of assuming a package manager, and answers "is it in sync?" on all four axes - machine, source, remote, and what was never provisioned at all.
